comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Edited update information: New memorial albums related to St. Petersburg, Xanadu and Port Royal can be found in-game as of Chapter 2: Astronomy's release. For Russia, you will need Adept of Ages (18th Century-P.3); note that only the following three recipes count for the new album, "Russian Clothing Culture". None of the others count for the memorial album, so don't bother wasting ingredients on them unless you wanted the gear they produced.

City Girl (close to the Bank):
Russian noblemen’s luxurious ensemble sewing
Sewing r14, 50 Felt + 15 Goldwork + 20 Fine fur
Long Vest and Half Kaftan
+1 Luxuries Trading

Russian noblewomen’s luxurious ensemble sewing
Sewing r14, 40 Felt + 20 Gold Thread + 20 Fine fur
Sarafan
+1 Luxuries Trading

Travelling Merchant NPC (outside the Cathedral in St. Petersburg):
Russian leather boots recipe (R10)
x20 Leather Cords
x10 Suede
Russian Boots

Thanks also to Destry for information on the two sewing recipes. Since Felt is still not available at St. Petersburg (only 61k development), Arctic sea shipwrecks or company shops (where Felt is sometimes found for fairly high prices) are your only option for Felt at the moment.

Xanadu's recipes can be accessed from Aide Production with the Adept of Ages (14th Century) title equipped; no trip to East Asia necessary to produce the items, thankfully. Lacking that title, I'll leave it up to someone else more knowledgeable in that field than I to report the recipes (3 needed for the album).

Port Royal's recipes seem to only be found inside of Port Royal (1m entry fee to non-pirates) with the Adept of Ages (17th Century-P.4) title equipped. 3 items needed for this album as well, all of them requiring notoriety to equip:

R11 Handicrafts: Pirate's Boots
Gold x15
Fine dye x5
Leather x10

R13 Sewing: Tortuga Pirates
Cotton Fabric x60
Gold x20
Leather x20

R15 Sewing: Buccaneer's Dress
Lace x30
Satin x40
Leather x2

Don't know where the NPCs are with these recipes in Port Royal, but it's not a very large town to search. If I've made any mistakes, my apologies; cheers, and great voyaging online to you.

Album reward items (screenshots): eririndol.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-228.html

comments.body:
To successfully fill out an album, one must:

Craft the item personally using a recipe book and corresponding skill, such as Casting
Purchase it from an NPC run item shop or trade market
Acquire the item by plundering an NPC ship or landing point or dungeon enemy
Fish/Collect/Procure the target trade good at sea or in a landing point
Obtain the desired item via an item box like those received from beginner school, or from opening a dungeon treasure chest, or a shipwreck treasure chest
Perform a Nanban Exchange

Player exchanges, purchasing from player and aide bazaars or company shops, plundering players' trade goods as a pirate, and Sailor Bottle drops or Astro Shop purchases, do not register any entries in a Memorial Album. Sometimes there are special items like New Year Boxes that randomly drop some Album items, but the surest way to fill out an album, is follow the steps listed above.

Yes, but with some restrictions.

1. The city you want to produce them at must be in Industrial Revolution "Boom" status (Manchester always is).
2. Some level of development is apparently required. I know English players have had no problem seeing those recipes appear at their Blast Furnace, but a Venetian reportedly didn't see those recipes at Cattaro. Investment in the city may also play a role, though I currently don't believe it does.
